description: handle_mdn_send does not CRLF-check the items in mdn.error (Option<Vec<String>>). RFC 8098 defines an Error: header field that backends would populate from Mdn.error. A client supplying CR or LF in any error string bypasses the handler's injection guard. Same vulnerability class as the original_recipient omission (JMAP-o68r.1). The fix is to add a loop over mdn.error items similar to the extension_fields loop: if let Some(ref errors) = mdn.error { for e in errors { if \!check_no_crlf(e) { crlf_bad = true; break; } } }. Trigger: MDN/send with error item containing \r\n passed to a backend that builds Error: headers.
title: Missing CRLF check on error Vec<String> items in handle_mdn_send
